description:
In server.rs mta_sts_handler, the Host header processing does strip_prefix('mta-sts.').unwrap_or(&host_no_port). The unwrap_or fallback means that a request with Host: example.com (no mta-sts. prefix) also matches a configured domain and receives a 200 policy response. Per RFC 8461 §3.3, the MTA-STS policy URL is always https://mta-sts.<domain>/.well-known/mta-sts.txt; requests that do not arrive via the mta-sts. subdomain are not legitimate policy fetches. This could expose the policy to a reverse proxy that rewrites Host, or to any direct request to the server. The handler should return 404 when the mta-sts. prefix is absent.

## Context
server.rs lines 377-379. RFC 8461 §3.3 specifies the policy URL always uses the mta-sts. subdomain.
title: mta_sts_handler: policy served to requests without 'mta-sts.' Host prefix
